topic: Mastering Putnam Competition Problem-Solving: The Art of Symmetry and Invariants

sections.title: Introduction: The Putnam Mindset (30 seconds)
lecture_lines: Putnam problems require elegant, hidden structural patterns.
Focus on reduction to simplicity, not rote calculation.
animations: Fade in title: The Putnam Mindset. Color: #FFFFFF. Change color to #FFD700.
Display logic: Structural simplification over rote calculation. Color: #FFD700.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Invariance (60 seconds)
lecture_lines: An invariant remains unchanged under specific operations.
Observe systems deforming while key properties stay fixed.
animations: Display formula: I(s) = C. Label: Invariant. Color: #FF00FF.

sections.title: Core Strategy: Exploiting Symmetry (90 seconds)
lecture_lines: Identify symmetry in polynomials and functional equations.
Use substitution to create mirror-image systems.
Visualize balance beams pivoting at center points.
animations: Display symmetric structure. Label: Symmetry. Color: #00CED1.

sections.title: Application: The Pigeonhole Principle & Extremal Methods (90 seconds)
lecture_lines: Pigeonhole Principle bounds potential problem outcomes.
Use extremal thinking to force a contradiction.
Analyze the largest or smallest elements effectively.
Find the most distant point from boundaries.
animations: Identify extreme elements in set. Color: #FF4500.

sections.title: Closing: Verification & Final Polish (30 seconds)
lecture_lines: Verify boundary conditions to ensure solution rigor.
Check trivial cases for consistency and polish.
animations: Fade in checklist: Rigor and Boundary Check. Color: #FFFFFF.
